funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Small, up to £2,000; Large, from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals at any stage of their career; applicant must be the author or editor of the proposed publication, with a publisher confirmed and a publication date scheduled within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to disseminate research on British art through the publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles, covering costs such as images, subventions, external contributors' fees and translation costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed. Organisations can only apply for one Research Project Grant per round.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research projects in the field of British art, primarily supporting staff costs towards a research project with public-facing outcomes and/or legacy.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; the exhibition on which the publication is based can be forthcoming or already taken place.
opportunities.summary: Support for the costs of exhibition publications showcasing new and original research on British art, including image and production costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to disseminate research on British art through live, online and hybrid events intended for a variety of audiences, covering costs such as venue hire, accommodation for speakers and staffing.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking a conservation research project or technical analysis; items supported must be in public or charitable ownership and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Funding to help protect and preserve significant works of British art by supporting organisations to undertake original and needed conservation research, including staff and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking work to digitise items and material in their own collections.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for organisations seeking to make their collections freely available to audiences online via digitisation, covering personnel and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA) Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a Member of Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA); those with pending membership may apply.
opportunities.summary: Micro-grant of up to £250 to help ERBA members cover transport, accommodation and reasonable expenses for a specific research trip, such as visiting a library, archive, collection or site, or travelling to meet a key contact or attend a research-related event.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals at any stage of career for grants up to £8,000; grants of £8,001-£20,000 available to those at postdoctoral level or with equivalent research experience or above. Open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals to undertake research in British art, supporting research time (including backfill for those in employment) and/or research travel to view collections or visit archives, plus some additional costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals enrolled to start (with a place confirmed) or already undertaking a master's level or doctoral level degree in the field of British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals beginning or continuing a master's or doctoral degree in British art who may face barriers in undertaking their course of study.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to registered students at undergraduate level and above, from any country.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for registered students to undertake research trips to examine British works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours) from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £32,000 for one year, or split over two years if part time

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a master's degree place at a UK-based institution, due to begin the course between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) in the field of British art, designed to bring new perspectives to the understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £96,000, awarded as £32,000 a year for three years (or split over further years if required)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a doctorate degree at a UK-based university, starting between April 2027 and April 2028. International applicants not qualifying for home fees may apply but the amount is fixed at £32,000/year.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support doctoral research in the field of British art, designed to pay university fees with the remainder supporting living expenses, and to expand understanding of British art through new perspectives.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: one year at £35,000, or two years at £70,000 (paid £35,000 per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at postdoctoral level (or with equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to undertake a major in-depth research project in the field of British art that will reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: full board and accommodation at the British School at Rome for three months, as well as an honorarium

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre-doctoral PhD candidates to those internationally recognised in their field.
opportunities.summary: A three-month residency at the British School at Rome for individuals undertaking advanced research relating to cultural contact, exchange and influence between Britain and Italy.
